operations.description: List every alert rule of the organization in one answer, unpaged and with no time filter; a consumer diffs the definitions it read before

List the annotations of a from/to window in epoch milliseconds, at most limit per call; type alert reads alert state history. While a page holds limit items, ask again with to set to the smallest time on it and deduplicate by id; a page with fewer items than limit is the last
List dashboards (type dash-db, required) matching query, tag or folderUIDs, one page per call: page from 1, limit the page size; a page with fewer hits than limit is the last. No time filter
Read one dashboard by uid: its JSON model under dashboard and its metadata under meta
List every data source the token may read in one answer, unpaged: uid, name, type and url of each, such as the Prometheus and Loki data sources the connection reaches

Evaluate a PromQL instant query on the Prometheus data source uid (letters, digits, - and _, at most 40) through Grafana's data-source proxy, at time (RFC 3339 or Unix seconds) or now; answers Prometheus's JSON value, written compact with object keys sorted

Evaluate a PromQL range query on the Prometheus data source uid (letters, digits, - and _, at most 40) through Grafana's data-source proxy, from start to end (both inclusive, RFC 3339 or Unix seconds) every step (a duration or seconds); Prometheus refuses more than 11,000 points per series. Answers Prometheus's JSON value, written compact with object keys sorted

Run a LogQL query on the Loki data source uid (letters, digits, - and _, at most 40) through Grafana's data-source proxy, from start (inclusive) to end (exclusive), nanosecond Unix epochs or RFC 3339, at most limit entries (1 to 5000), direction backward (newest first, the default) or forward; answers Loki's JSON value, written compact with object keys sorted
